Roof Tiles

Mangalore-pattern clay roof tiles used across the sloped roofs, giving the block its traditional Kerala silhouette while shedding the region's monsoon rainfall.

Handmade Athangudi cement tiles in a traditional floral pattern, used for flooring to bring in regional craft character and a naturally cool underfoot finish.
